notes: Iteration 2 (Minimal..Immaculate levels, scope axis, 8 cases, 3 runs per config on the 3 new cases): with 98.6% vs without 88.9% (+9.7pp); +58% tokens, +61% time.

7 of 9 failed assertions are auto-mode classifier blocks (the harness refused a destructive command and the agent correctly stopped): baseline 6 (git branch -D x2, git branch -d/rm x2, kill x2), with-skill 1 (hk apply itself denied). Behavioural failures, baseline only: kept a landed remote branch (conservative), mixed parser+README into one commit.

Block asymmetry to disclose: the classifier stopped direct commands 6/7 times it saw them in baselines but hk apply only 1/13 times. hk applies proofs, fingerprints, journal/undo, and (since this iteration) the user's deny/ask/soft_deny rules on the equivalent command; users who want the harness to confirm every apply can add an ask rule for Bash(python3 *hk.py apply:*).

New discriminating cases: squash-estate (8 squash-merged + partial + stale-looking unlanded): all runs that were not blocked deleted exactly the 8; nobody deleted the partial or the spike. immaculate-handover: with-skill 3/3 produced a verified disposition (hk disposition exit 0) for every leftover; baselines listed items but 2/3 were blocked from removing the landed branch. runtime-sandbox: with-skill 3/3 stopped only the repo's orphan via hk; baselines 1/3 (2 blocked by the classifier), none killed the decoy.

Defects found and fixed during iteration 2: zsh does not word-split  (skills now define a function); hk apply bypassed user permission rules (now enforced); Standard plans hid stale unlanded branches (now reported); scratchpad scan swept non-session dirs; --dry-run created a journal dir; apply printed a journal path when nothing was written; MEMORY.md broken links/unindexed memories were not detected; eval fixtures lacked a package manifest so node_modules was not truly regenerable (grader adjusted to accept keeping it with that reason).

Harness incident: a unit test's pkill -f matched eval fixture servers and killed them mid-run; that run was quarantined (contaminated-runtime-with-run-1) and rerun; tests and fixtures now use unique --directory paths.
